task_definition.task_name: Phase Picking using PhaseNet on STEAD

task_description.overview: Use a pretrained PhaseNet deep‐learning model to detect P‐ and S‐wave arrivals on the 3-component seismic dataset (STEAD).
steps: Load multi‐component seismic data from the provided .npz file.
Normalize each component trace by mean removal and max (or standard deviation) scaling.
Convert normalized data into a PyTorch tensor and move it to the computation device (CPU/GPU).
Run the PhaseNet model in evaluation mode to obtain probability sequences for noise, P‐phase, and S‐phase.
Detect arrival picks in the probability sequences using a peak‐detection function with specified probability thresholds and minimum peak distance.
Return sample indices and associated probabilities for the detected P and S picks.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Perform P-wave and S-wave phase picking on the 3-component seismic dataset (STEAD) using PhaseNet. Load and normalize the seismic data from {data_path}. The pretrained PhaseNet model is located at {pretrained_model_path}, and its pretrained parameters is located at {pretrained_param_path}. 
 (1) Run inference with the specific overlap, P_threshold, and S_threshold, save the picked results into a csv file, and assign `-1` when no valid p-picks or s-picks is found for a sample. 
 (2) Load the target P and S picks from {target_path} by reading the columns `p_arrival_sample` and `s_arrival_sample`. Plot a figure (2 subplots) showing the comparison between the predicted and Target P-wave picks and S-wave picks. 
 (3) The result data should be saved to {result_data.save_name} with content {result_data.content}, and the result figure should be saved to {result_figure}.
